next_step: Run 4-week POC: import 12M docs into pgvector connector, validate hybrid BM25+embedding rerank, measure p95 latency and cost per query; schedule infra deep-dive week of 2025-01-20
notes: Lead: CTO Rajiv Menon. Primary pain: semantic recall falls off at scale, current Elastic keyword layer fine but semantic layer costs explode. Wants a hybrid architecture: BM25 candidate generation in Elastic + embedding-based rerank. Strong constraint: all customer data must remain in-region (US) and live behind their VPC with KMS-managed keys. Interested in both managed (Pinecone) and self-hosted (pgvector inside Aurora / Weaviate self-hosted) options. Quoted: 'We need under 100ms p95 for QA flows and < $0.01 per avg query for high-throughput scenarios.' Prefers connector that supports streaming upserts, per-document metadata filters, TTL, vector dimension changes without full reindex, and bulk backfill tooling. Open to Dedicated for reranker model hosting. AE to push pricing scenarios + ingestion playbook.

connector_requirements: per-document metadata filtering and boolean/term filters for candidate pruning
support for hybrid search (BM25 -> dense rerank) and ability to persist BM25 candidates alongside vectors
TTL and partitioning to manage 40M doc cold storage
observability: ingestion metrics, per-index QPS, p95 latency, and cost estimates
native pgvector compatibility desired for co-located data; Weaviate acceptable if connector supports BYO vector storage and replication
offline reindex strategy and schema migration with minimal downtime
use_case_and_requirements_summary: Goal: replace low-accuracy semantic layer with a staged RAG pipeline: fast BM25 candidate gen in Elastic (existing), dense embeddings for similarity + lightweight reranker for precision. Indexing scale 30-50M docs. SLOs: p95 <=100ms for exploratory QA; throughput: baseline 30 QPS, spikes 150 QPS. Cost target: ~<$0.01 avg per query for typical traffic patterns. Must run inside customer VPC, KMS-managed keys, audit logs exported to SIEM.
poc_plan: Phase 1 (2 weeks): ingest 12M sample docs into pgvector + Redwood-hosted reranker; run latency and recall benchmarks. Phase 2 (2 weeks): stress QPS 150, measure tail latency and cost per query; compare against hosted Pinecone baseline. Deliverable: recommendation (pgvector self-hosted vs Dedicated + Pinecone) with cost model and rollout plan.
sales_play_notes: High-opportunity account: enterprise compliance + scale. Win if we demonstrate connector parity and better unit economics than Pinecone at scale + reliable reranker hosting. Upsell path: Dedicated capacity + Redwood Optimize for batching/caching suggestions.
